payload.title: Security & stability audit remediation (post-v0.1.1)
payload.description: Tracking epic for the deep adversarial audit of all changes since v0.1.1 (907 files / 218 commits). 70 findings confirmed after 2-skeptic adversarial verification: 3 critical, 16 high, 29 medium, 19 low, 3 info. Each child bug carries the finding id, file:lines, impact, and suggested fix.
